english.title: Postal service - non-employee / agent of authorised person convey letter
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who was not acting as an employee or agent of a person acting under the authority of a licence issued by the Postal Services Commission to convey a letter, conveyed a letter from one place, namely **(..SPECIFY DESPATCH LOCATION..) to another, namely **(..SPECIFY RECEIPT LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(2) of the Postal Services Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) No proceedings shall be instigated in England or Wales in respect of an offence under Section 6(2) except by or on behalf of the Postal Services Commission or the Secretary of State.
(ii) See Section 6(6) for "conveying a letter"
(iii) See section 7 for exceptions

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
INDICTMENT: A fine

6 months
